addedPeppers.fact: The Apollo Pepper is a reported Pepper X and Carolina Reaper cross known publicly through The Last Dab Apollo hot sauce. PepperScale lists an unofficial 3,000,000 SHU figure.
addedPeppers.accuracyNote: PepperScale presents 3,000,000 SHU as an unofficial reported figure. A public lab result and the raw pod's appearance have not been released; the permitted source image shows The Last Dab Apollo sauce rather than a pepper pod.
